interpretation: Studio was requested locally with view=x; safe offline tool base URL omits the query.
Search was requested locally with query=community; noindex is intentional.
Legacy post alias intentionally points to its existing canonical.
HTML was captured at several local repair checkpoints, before the final group summary and reaction guard.
Final group summary was inspected separately at 390 CSS pixels.
This baseline does not measure live indexation, search clicks, rankings, visitors or AI citations.
